payload.title: CTR-PSES: Publish additive Provider Sessions root contract slices
payload.exclusiveLease: direct Go files in pkg/services/provider_sessions root contract
payload.requestedOutcome: Publish additive Provider Sessions root-contract slices for detached providers.SessionRef inspection and provider-independent transcript/reasoning/tool/parse/usage detail. Unblock IMP-PSES-* after CTR-PROV lands; do not absorb Standardized Providers catalog/execution or the live neutral-conductor workers lease.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Provider Sessions exposes one named root interface with plain request/result/value/typed-error contracts for detached-ref validation/inspection and normalized transcript/detail projection.
Public contracts accept a typed providers.SessionRef identity without importing provider execution, enumeration, availability, capability, or Workers selection policy.
No peer implementation, filesystem/SQL/OS effect types, or private Codex/Cursor reader types appear in the published root contract.
A fake peer can implement the published slices; representative success and typed failure characterization tests pass.
Typecheck/lint and focused Provider Sessions contract tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Root contract slices only; do not complete IMP-PSES nested reader cuts in this packet.
Do not take CTR-PROV/IMP-PROV, Standardized Providers conductor/migration, or CLI-manifest leases.
Do not edit pkg/services/workers construction paths owned by the live neutral-conductor lane.
Do not change public OpenAPI solely for package motion.
Do not import or reimplement Providers catalog/execution behavior.
verification: focused Provider Sessions contract characterization tests

Typecheck/lint and focused Factory Visualization contract tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Root contract slices only; nested IMP-VIS packets remain separate.
Do not take Wire/root, CLI-manifest, provider-conductor, or Packaged Factory materialization leases.
Do not change public OpenAPI solely for package motion.
Do not move transport HTTP/CLI/MCP presentation ownership into this packet.
verification: focused Factory Visualization contract characterization tests
